evidence: We demonstrate the impact of reducing agents for Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) and Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) of WS2 from WF6 and H2S precursors. ... The first publications on WF6/H2S ALD by Scharf et al. in the field of tribological coatings for microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) report 10-100nm thick poly-crystalline WS2 layers that contain high levels of Zn-impurities (10 at%) as diethylzinc was needed to initiate and maintain the growth process. ... In this work, we have combined WF6 and H2S with semiconductor compatible reducing agents that, as we will show, are effective, i.e. thin solid Si layers and H2 plasma.
